name: post guard
pitch: Scans a draft post for risky content before it is published.
instructions:
# Post guard

Before publishing, read the draft and look for anything that could cause regret later. Check for:
- Mentions of real people without their consent.
- Private facts, home addresses, phone numbers, or ID numbers.
- Strong language, slurs, or harassing remarks.
- References to illegal acts or drug use.
- Anything that could damage professional or personal relationships.

When you find a possible issue, highlight the exact text and say why it might be risky. If the draft is clean, say so and give it the all-clear.

At the end, show a short summary of what you checked and any flags you raised. Do not edit the post unless the person asks you to.

examples.ask: check my draft before I post it
examples.does: reads the draft, points out any risky spots, and reports back with a summary.

readme:
# post guard
Scans a draft post for anything that could come back to bite the person before publishing. Reads the text, flags risky content, and gives a summary. Will not edit the post or publish anything without permission.
